preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 58.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n and 1 <= r_i <= n for b_i, r_i in arcs)
preconditions.description: Each blue and red arc must point to a valid vertex between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v < n for v, s in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query vertex v must be a valid vertex between 1 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n - 1 and all(c in 'RB' for c in s) for v, s in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string s must have length n-1 and consist only of characters 'R' and 'B'.

postconditions.description: Output -1 if the state is unreachable, otherwise output the first time t_i when the state appears.
The time t_i must be a non-negative integer.
The time t_i must not exceed 2^60, ensuring it fits within standard integer limits.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in vertices)
invariants.description: All vertices must be within the valid range from 1 to n.
The number of arcs must be exactly n-1.

invariants.expression: all(len(s) == n - 1 for v, s in queries)
invariants.description: Each query string s must have a length of n-1.
